Post Date: April 4, 2025

12:02 pm

Lalit Narayan Mithila University (LNMU), The official website has released a notification for the Examination to the B. Ed. Common Entrance Test (CET-BED)-2025 For Regular, Distance and Shiksha Shastri 02 Years Course 2025. The LNMU application form started on 04th April 2025, and candidates can fill out the form until 02th May 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for the Bihar CET B.Ed Online Form 2025, which are given below.

Bihar CET B.Ed Online Form 2025 : Admission Details
Exam Name Education Qualification
 

Bihar CET B.Ed

  • To be eligible for the B.Ed. Programme, candidates must have secured at least 50% marks in their Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in fields like Science, Social Science, Humanities, or Commerce. Those with a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Technology, specializing in Science or Mathematics, must have a minimum of 55% marks. Equivalent qualifications are also accepted.

  • For the Shiksha Shastri (B.Ed. in Sanskrit) course, candidates must have 50% marks in a Bachelor’s degree with Sanskrit as the main subject and a Master’s degree in Sanskrit or Acharya in traditional Sanskrit Shastra. Alternatively, those who have passed Shastri (B.A. including Sanskrit) with 50% marks and have completed a 2-year Acharya (MA Sanskrit) course must also pass a Bridge Course. However, marks from the first year of Acharya/MA will not be considered in the final percentage calculation.

  • Interested candidates who wish to Fill for the LNMU post can submit their application online before 02 May 2025.
  • Use the click here link provided below under important link section to apply directly.
  • Alternatively, visit the official website of LNMU to complete the application process online.
  • Make sure to complete the application before the deadline 02 May 2025.

  • Must have completed their 10+2 (Intermediate) or High School level exam, with English and Hindi as compulsory subjects.

  • For special categories (PWD, Ex-servicemen, etc.), relevant supporting documents.

  • Aadhaar card, voter ID, or any other government-issued ID for identity verification.
Other Relevant Documents
  • Any other document mentioned in the REET official notification specific to the candidate’s category or qualification.
